title: Rolls keyed on (seed, step) alone — a free INVENTORY no-op rerolls any check
body:
Deferred from the 2026-08-28/29 audit fix pass. The finding was confirmed by an
adversarial verifier; it was not fixed in that pass for the reason below, which is
the fixing agent's own account after reading the code.

Owner product decision, not a code slip. The verifier's own correction says the (seed, step) keying is documented intent (src/core/rng.ts:4-7) and that the finding is a design consequence with no compensating mitigation. Every candidate fix is architectural: mixing the action or a state digest into the stream re-keys every recorded trace, every per-step hash, every pinned save digest and the RNG known-answer vector (tests/regression/rng_known_answer_vector.test.ts), and the cheaper mitigations (making INVENTORY not advance `step`, or a per-check counter) are game-design calls about the difficulty economy that belong to the repo owner and reach well outside src/core. Not something to decide unilaterally mid-audit.
